title: Standard WOFOST one-day evolution readiness gate

WOF25_G01_complete_continuation_state.result: common state is crop_emerged, DVS, TSUM, fl_anthesis, nofd, atmin7 plus F-WOF23 biomass/cohorts; IDSL2 adds vern and fl_vernalised

WOF25_G02_minimal_committed_state.result: derived fields and inactive-option state are excluded; no fixed 366-cohort allocation is required

WOF25_G03_rates_are_not_state.result: dtsum, dvr, daylp, vernrate and WOFOST_rates remain event-local
WOF25_G03_rates_are_not_state.reference_hold: exact legacy post-vernalised VERN output requires compatibility or expected-difference qualification

WOF25_G04_daily_forcing_contract.result: TMN, TAV, TAVD, radiation, solar geometry and active CO2 factors are explicit event/provider inputs; hidden calendar globals are forbidden

WOF25_G05_cross_process_aggregates.result: IQROT/IPTRA/IALPWET are accepted window aggregates only; rejected soil-water trials contribute zero
WOF25_G05_cross_process_aggregates.option_hold: production owner for active oxygen IALPWET window accumulation across composed runtime intervals is not claimed by F-WOF25

WOF25_G06_explicit_evolution_event.result: one explicit crop event/window with [t0,t1], first admitted duration one day; runtime schedules it and kernel time remains generic

WOF25_G07_transaction_semantics.result: prepare, aggregate and finalize are candidate-only; F-KT remains the only commit/rollback authority; discard and deterministic replay tests are specified

WOF25_G08_soil_water_cadence.result: many soil-water substeps may occur inside a crop window; WOFOST evolution occurs once at its physical cadence

WOF25_G09_threshold_event_semantics.result: emergence, anthesis, vernalization, cohort shifting, root changes and maturity are cadence-sensitive; arbitrary split/merge equivalence is explicitly unqualified

WOF25_G10_MultiSWAP_scalability.result: parameter sharing, compact active cohorts, option-dependent state and worker-local rates are compatible with SoA/pools/batching

readiness_decision.meaning: the zero-production source-bound contracts are sufficient to start a separate smallest structural candidate without inventing missing state or cadence semantics

recommended_first_structural_profile.IDSL: prefer 0 or 1 initially so the post-vernalised VERN compatibility hold is outside the first production seam
recommended_first_structural_profile.root_state: prefer a route with reconstructible/nonadaptive root geometry before composing optional SWRD2/SWRDC1 history
recommended_first_structural_profile.oxygen_same_window_export: exclude initially unless the runtime accepted-window aggregator owner is composed explicitly

holds_not_blocking_restricted_structural: IDSL2 exact post-vernalised VERN diagnostic compatibility
production runtime owner for active oxygen IALPWET crop-window accumulation across smaller committed intervals
concrete optional SWRD2/SWRDC1 root-history carrier composition
arbitrary subdaily or multiday WOFOST evolution
next_unit_rule: do not start production work in F-WOF25; choose the next free F-WOF work-unit code live and make it the smallest structural one-day candidate constrained by the profile above
